WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) as avg_usage
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
),
station_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    AVG(bandusagepct) as station_avg
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
)
SELECT 
  AVG(sa.station_avg) as mean_bandwidth_usage,
  AVG(sa.station_avg - oa.avg_usage) as how_far_above_average
FROM station_avgs sa
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE sa.station_avg > oa.avg_usage
